notes.title: VR Formula:Update
notes.notes:
・Support non-VR
If the VR device is not connected, it automatically switches to non-VR PC mode.
Info http://steamcommunity.com/app/673840/discussions/0/1694914735995048235/

・Support steering wheel
In the case of VR mode, pressing L1 and R1 (joystick button 5 and button 6) in the title switches to the operation setting of the steering wheel.
Info http://steamcommunity.com/app/673840/discussions/0/1694914735995057450/

· The name of the course was partially changed
